model: Per-gene z-score normalization of log-scaled expression; PCA/leiden clustering on z-scores; malignant clusters identified by high melanocyte signature (MITF/PAX3/SOX10/TYR/PMEL/PDLIM4) and low pan-immune signature; non-malignant types assigned by best-scoring marker panel (T, B, macrophage, endothelial, fibroblast/CAF, NK); markers from Welch t-test with BH FDR; malignant heterogeneity via l1-regularized NMF (k=4)
software_used: numpy 2.1.3, pandas 2.3.3, scanpy 1.12.1, anndata 0.12.16, scipy 1.14.1, scikit-learn 1.6.1, matplotlib 3.10.3; GEOparse installed via pip
